subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

__I have think__ tomorrow I will take my belongings to the new apartment.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**I think**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• The verb "**think**" is used to express thoughts or opinions.
 
• In this sentence, the speaker is expressing their thought about taking their belongings to the new apartment tomorrow.
 
• The original sentence is grammatically incorrect. The error lies in the use of "**have**" before "**think**."
 
• The verb "**have**" is not needed in this context.
 
• The correct tense to use here is present simple, which is "**I think**".
 
• In English, when expressing thoughts or plans, the verb "**think**" does not require an auxiliary verb like "**have**."

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.

**Corrected sentence**: *I think tomorrow I will take my belongings to the new apartment.*
